name: brownstone-careers-pages
description: Brownstone Careers autonomous recruitment operating system with Windows-compatible canonical Cloudflare Turnstile recovery, governed workflow automation, ranked stage intelligence, administrator-managed AI evaluation, private onboarding, unified communications, scheduled operations health, and human-controlled hiring decisions.

scripts.check: node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/site-audit.mjs && node scripts/seo-audit.mjs && node scripts/test-emails.mjs && node scripts/test-mobile-menu.mjs && node scripts/workforce-audit.mjs && node scripts/supabase-audit.mjs && node scripts/domain-routing-audit.mjs && node scripts/turnstile-audit.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && node scripts/test-forms.mjs && npm run build
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@latest pages dev dist
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@latest pages deploy --project-name brownstone-careers --branch main
scripts.db:migrate: npx --yes wrangler@latest d1 migrations apply brownstone-workforce --remote
